kyc.title: Identity verification
kyc.consentText: I consent to TezFiks processing photos of my ID card, my selfies and my trade documents solely to verify my identity and qualifications. These images are shown only to TezFiks administrators, every view is logged, and they are deleted 30 days after the decision.
kyc.stepsId: Front and back of your ID card
kyc.stepsSelfie: Three short selfies: look straight, turn your head, blink

idFront.title: Front of the ID
idFront.instruction: Place the ID inside the frame. All text must be readable

idBack.title: Back of the ID
idBack.instruction: Turn the ID over and place the back inside the frame

selfieFront.instruction: Fit your face inside the oval and look straight at the camera

selfieTurn.title: Selfie: turn your head
selfieTurn.instruction: Slowly turn your head to the right and take the photo

selfieBlink.title: Selfie: blink
selfieBlink.instruction: Look at the camera, blink and take the photo

device.intro: Check these settings to receive orders on time
device.notificationsBody: Sound and vibration when a new order arrives
device.locationBody: Needed to receive nearby orders while you are online (only while the app is open or the online notification is active)
device.batteryIntro: {{device}} may stop background apps to save battery. Turn the restriction off for TezFiks Pro:
device.testBody: Check that your phone rings and vibrates when a new order arrives
device.testAlertBody: This is a test offer — sound and vibration work
device.testSent: Test alert sent. If there was no sound or vibration, check the notification permission and the sound mode.

battery.samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → add TezFiks Pro to "Never sleeping apps".
battery.xiaomi: Settings → Apps → TezFiks Pro → Battery saver → choose "No restrictions" and enable "Autostart".
battery.huawei: Settings → Battery → App launch → turn off automatic management for TezFiks Pro and enable all three options.
battery.oppo: Settings → Battery → TezFiks Pro → "Allow background activity" and enable auto launch.
battery.vivo: Settings → Battery → High background power consumption → allow TezFiks Pro.
battery.oneplus: Settings → Battery → Battery optimization → TezFiks Pro → "Don't optimize".
battery.generic: Settings → Battery → Battery optimization: turn optimization off for TezFiks Pro.

settings.title: Settings
settings.priceIntro: Choose who enters the final price of an order when the job is done. The rule applies to all handymen of the company.
settings.workerBody: When the job is done the handyman types the final price on the phone — the manager is notified
settings.managerBody: The handyman finishes the job, the manager enters and confirms the price in the app. The handyman's screen has no price step
settings.howBody: Whichever mode you choose, the order is not closed without a price and the amount is shown in the customer's app for confirmation. Solo handymen always enter the price themselves.
